page_title: RSO 0-1 SEV | Real Sociedad v Sevilla 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Victor Garcia is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+5' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
90+4' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Real Sociedad win a corner.
90+2' Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by Unai Marrero.
90+2' It's time for a substitution. Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) comes on in place of Dodi Lukebakio.
90+1' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) is very lucky to stay on the pitch after using excessive force to bring down his opponent with a two-footed challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' Real Sociedad are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
88' Orjan Nyland (Sevilla) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
86' A short through ball almost allows Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
84' Substitution. Saul Niguez is replaced by Peque (Sevilla).

83' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a throw-in.
82' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
80' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
78' Substitution. Sergio Gomez makes way for Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
78' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

78' What a great touch by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
76' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Orjan Nyland is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
75' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

75' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

74' Real Sociedad slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
72' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
70' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) replaces Isaac Romero.
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) is replacing Chidera Ejuke.

67' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
66' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
63' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the left post!
61' Here's the change. Sheraldo Becker leaves the pitch and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
61' Benat Turrientes goes off the pitch and Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) comes on.
61' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Jon Ander Olasagasti and he is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
61' We are about to witness a subsitution. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) for Jon Aramburu.
59' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.
57' Real Sociedad are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
54' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
52' Sevilla show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
49' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
46' 0 - 1 Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
46' Referee Victor Garcia blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
45' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) takes a short corner kick.
44' Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Victor Garcia who sees an offensive foul.
43' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
43' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.
42' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but it's cleared.
40' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
38' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.

34' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad will have a goal kick.
33' Some great play by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Unai Marrero sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
33' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
30' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
30' The ball is cleared after Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
27' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.

24' A pass travels right across the box to Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the right post, but Orjan Nyland denies him with a decent save.
23' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. It's a throw-in for Sevilla.
21' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
21' Nayef Aguerd (Real Sociedad) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards goal, but Orjan Nyland makes a magnificent save!
21' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
20' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and signals a foul after Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) brought his opponent down. Real Sociedad get a free kick.
20' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
18' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

16' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
15' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) will take the corner.

14' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman makes the right call and Real Sociedad will have a corner.
14' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
13' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
9' Sevilla are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
6' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
4' Wonderful movement by Real Sociedad. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
2' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
2' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.

The players are out and the match is about to start. Sevilla will have the kick-off.
